headline: US Opposition Wins Control of House and Senate in Midterm Elections
summary: The opposition party secured majorities in both the House of Representatives and the Senate in the US midterm elections.
why: Congressional shifts in the United States alter the legislative landscape, influencing fiscal policy, federal spending priorities, and regulatory agendas.
